name: Lumen Arc
description: A sunlike star arcing through the outer arm with a full set: rock, ocean, giant, belt, and dwarf. The ocean world hosts simple life while the giant's shadow shelters prospectors. It reads like a textbook system that wandered off the page.

stars.name: Lumen
stars.description: A textbook yellow dwarf with textbook output and textbook manners. Its spectrum calibrates instruments across three sectors. Nothing about it surprises anyone, which surprises everyone.

planets.name: Primer
planets.description: A basalt textbook world, cratered exactly as much as the models predict. Survey academies run field exams on its surface. Nothing ever happens here, which is the point.

planets.name: Second Primer
planets.description: A shallow ocean world greening at the edges with patient simple life. Research leases cover every coastline twice over. Its tides run like the diagrams say they should.

planets.name: Overlook
planets.description: A mid-sized giant presiding over the outer system with diagram-perfect bands. Its shadow shelters the belt prospectors from the worst weather. Students learn gravity assists in its lee.

dwarfPlanets.name: Appendix
dwarfPlanets.description: A small rocky dwarf filed at the back of every survey like an afterthought. Its composition matches the textbook average suspiciously well. Graduate students are assigned it as a joke that keeps producing papers.

belts.name: Arc Kuiper
belts.description: A broad icy belt exactly where the formation models place it. Cold classicals preserve primordial chemistry in deep freeze. Sample returns write themselves.
